## Key Amenities

- Outdoor swimming pool (shallow kids' section, loungers)
- 2+ acres of landscaped gardens & lawns
- Outdoor party lawn (capacity up to 300 guests)
- Home-style Konkan & multi-cuisine restaurant
- Free high-speed Wi-Fi | 100% power backup
- Kids' play area | Indoor games (carrom, chess, cards)
- Rain dance | BBQ & bonfire setups | Badminton
- Free private parking (cars + coaches)

## Dining

Authentic Konkan and Maharashtrian cuisine:
- Surmai (kingfish) fry, Pomfret thali, Prawns masala, Solkadhi
- Kombdi Vade, Chicken sukka, vegetarian thali
- Breakfast (Poha, Misal Pav, Upma) | Multi-cuisine options
- Garden BBQ on request

## How to Reach

- **From Mumbai by ferry**: Gateway of India → Mandwa Jetty (55 min catamaran) → cab to resort (40 min)
- **From Mumbai by road**: NH 66 via Navi Mumbai → Panvel → Pen → Alibaug (~95 km, 2.5–3 hrs)
- **From Pune by road**: Expressway → Khopoli → Pen → Alibaug (~140 km, 3.5–4 hrs)
- **M2M Ferry**: Drive your car onto the Ro-Pax ferry from Bhaucha Dhakka to Mandwa

## Common Guest Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is the swimming pool included in room rates?**
A: Yes — all resident guests have free pool access daily 8 AM to 7 PM.

**Q: How far is Nagaon Beach from the resort?**
A: Approximately 2 km — about 5 minutes by auto-rickshaw or cab.

**Q: Can we host a wedding or birthday party here?**
A: Yes — open lawns for up to 300 guests, full catering, décor coordination and on-site accommodation.

**Q: What is the best time to visit Malhar Baug Resort?**
A: October to March (post-monsoon and winter) for pleasant weather and beach activities. Monsoon (June–September) is lush and scenic but beach water sports are limited.

**Q: Do you serve non-vegetarian food?**
A: Yes — fresh seafood (surmai, pomfret, prawns), chicken preparations, and vegetarian thalis all available daily.

**Q: Is parking available?**
A: Yes — free secure parking for private cars and tourist coaches.
